sources.marks: The athlete's face is fully frontal and recognisable (Mixkit stock model, covered by the Mixkit licence). To lose the face, the only option is a lower-body crop (y 0.45-1.0), which is soft after upscaling, so not recommended.

sources.marks: (1) A magenta advertising poster on the far tiled wall appears from about 10.3 s at roughly x 0.45-0.63, y 0.40-0.53 of the frame (static camera). Blur it or grade it down with a soft mask. (2) Faint station lettering on the far wall and a small red LED clock over the tunnel mouth at top-left (about x 0.03-0.2, y 0.36-0.40): darken them in the grade. (3) Passengers show through the lit windows from 0 to 9.5 s, small and motion-blurred but more readable at 0.5x. The 8.5-12.5 stretch has almost none; only use 0-4 s if they stay soft. (4) Car number '555' stencilled on the car sides around 2.5 s and 7 s. No watermark.

sources.licence: Public domain / CC0 (US Army film via National Archives, US government work, item licence http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). CAUTION: the diving segment is followed by a 'News of the Day, Copyright 1954' end card (59-64 s), so the underlying newsreel may carry its own copyright. Check it before broadcast.
sources.marks: None inside 25.5-28.0 (no lettering, insignia or faces). Things to avoid elsewhere in the reel: title supers 'OLYMPIC CHAMP IN SUPER-DIVING' (about 11-15 s), 'THE END / NEWS OF THE DAY / Copyright 1954' (about 59-64 s) and 'Ace Diving!' (about 65-69 s); close-ups of Sammy Lee, a named and recognisable person (11-17 s and 37-40 s, plus about 52-58 s); crowd close-ups (17-19 s and 47-49 s). Processing: deinterlace (yadif), scale 720x480 to 640x480 (square pixels), then crop to 9:16. Crop fractions are of the displayed 4:3 frame.

sources.licence: Public domain / CC0 (US Army film via National Archives). Same caution: the 'Ace Diving!' segment may be newsreel footage carrying its own copyright. Check it before broadcast.
sources.marks: Her face is in frame but soft and interlaced at this size, and she is unnamed, so it is not a recognisable likeness. Keep the grain, don't sharpen. The 'Ace Diving!' super ends about 68 s and is not in this stretch. The edge of a building or tower intrudes at top-right (x > 0.85), outside the crop. Deinterlace and scale to 640x480 as for the first choice.
